about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Introduction
description: I am a technology and software development enthusiast, passionate about transforming ideas into digital solutions that bring real value. My constant curiosity drives me to explore key areas of current and future technology, such as AI and data science.

I am motivated to learn and apply new tools and methodologies that enhance the creation of efficient and scalable projects. I enjoy tackling technical challenges and collaborating in multidisciplinary teams to achieve innovative solutions.

description.name: Data acquisition
description.text: Automation of processes to collect large volumes of medical images and associated metadata.

description.name: Preprocessing
description.text: Cleaning and normalization of images to ensure consistent and ready-to-use datasets.

description.name: Exploratory analysis
description.text: Study of distributions, correlations, biases and patterns through statistical analysis and visualizations.

description.name: Modeling
description.text: Training, tuning and ensembling of convolutional models based on state-of-the-art architectures.

description.name: Evaluation
description.text: Assessment of the final model’s performance using quantitative metrics, cross-validation and advanced visualizations.

description.name: Pipelines
description.text: Development of reproducible pipelines for preprocessing, training, evaluation and experiment management.
